# hallpass_api_token (Resource)

An API token issued by the provider's own (Administrator) token, for example a read-only Auditor token for an integration. It acts for the same operator as the provider's token, with the role given here, and is revoked together with the provider's token. `token` is known only to the Terraform run that creates it and is kept in state (sensitive): store it in your secret manager from the same configuration. Destroying the resource revokes the token. A token that expired or was revoked outside Terraform is created again on the next apply. To rotate, change `triggers` (with `create_before_destroy`, the old token stays valid until the new one is stored). Every argument forces a new token. Cannot be imported, because HallPass shows a token only once.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A read-only token for an integration, issued by the provider's Administrator token and stored in a secret manager.
resource "hallpass_api_token" "deed" {
  name          = "deed-connector"
  role          = "auditor"
  never_expires = true

  # Change the value to rotate; the old token stays valid until the new one is stored.
  triggers = { rotation = "2026-10" }

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# A short-lived token for a report job.
resource "hallpass_api_token" "weekly_report" {
  name            = "weekly-report"
  role            = "viewer"
  expires_in_days = 90
}

output "deed_token" {
  value     = hallpass_api_token.deed.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, after what uses the token (1-100 characters).
- `role` (String) Role of the token: `administrator`, `approver`, `auditor` or `viewer`. Pick the least the integration needs. Approvals and recordings stay console-only whatever the role.

### Optional

- `expires_in_days` (Number) Days until the token expires (1-366). Required unless `never_expires` is set.
- `never_expires` (Boolean) Issue a token without expiry. It still stops when revoked or when the operator it acts for is disabled or stops being an administrator. Defaults to `false`.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; changing any of them issues a new token (rotation).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the token was issued (RFC 3339).
- `expires_at` (String) When the token expires (RFC 3339); empty when it never expires.
- `hint` (String) Last four characters of the token, as the console shows it.
- `id` (String) API token ID (`atk_…`).
- `operator_id` (String) The operator the token acts for (the one behind the provider's token).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token (`hallpass_at_…`), for the integration's `Authorization: Bearer` header.
